XData.Data: <ruleDefinition alias="" context="EnsLib.HL7.MsgRouter.RoutingEngine" production="ADTIN.ADTIN"> <ruleSet name="" effectiveBegin="" effectiveEnd=""> <rule name="ADT LOAD BALANCE by XMRN"> <constraint name="source" value="In-PeaksEpic-Adt-Hl7tcp"></constraint> <constraint name="docCategory" value="SCL_EPIC_ALL_2_5"></constraint> <constraint name="docName" value=""></constraint> <when condition="RegexMatch(HL7.{PID:Patient Identifier List.IDNumber},"0$")||(RegexMatch(HL7.{PID:Patient Identifier List.IDNumber},"1$"))" comment=""> <trace value=""Matched 0 or 1""></trace> <send transform="" target="PeaksEpic-Adt-Hl7_IhcHie-Demogr-0"></send> </when> <when condition="RegexMatch(HL7.{PID:Patient Identifier List.IDNumber},"2$")||(RegexMatch(HL7.{PID:Patient Identifier List.IDNumber},"3$"))" comment=""> <trace value=""Matched 2 or 3""></trace> <send transform="" target="PeaksEpic-Adt-Hl7_IhcHie-Demogr-1"></send> </when> <when condition="RegexMatch(HL7.{PID:Patient Identifier List.IDNumber},"4$")||(RegexMatch(HL7.{PID:Patient Identifier List.IDNumber},"5$"))" comment=""> <trace value=""Matched 4 or 5""></trace> <send transform="" target="PeaksEpic-Adt-Hl7_IhcHie-Demogr-2"></send> </when> <when condition="RegexMatch(HL7.{PID:PatientIdentifierList().IDNumber},"6$")||(RegexMatch(HL7.{PID:PatientIdentifierList().IDNumber},"7$"))" comment=""> <trace value=""Matched 6 or 7""></trace> <send transform="" target="PeaksEpic-Adt-Hl7_IhcHie-Demogr-3"></send> </when> <when condition="RegexMatch(HL7.{PID:PatientIdentifierList().IDNumber},"8$")||(RegexMatch(HL7.{PID:PatientIdentifierList().IDNumber},"9$"))" comment=""> <trace value=""Matched 8 or 9""></trace> <send transform="" target="PeaksEpic-Adt-Hl7_IhcHie-Demogr-4"></send> </when> <otherwise> <trace value=""Did not match""></trace> </otherwise> </rule> </ruleSet> </ruleDefinition>
